summary: First-pass backend testing of City-Wide ANPR API. All 11 targeted areas verified against public URL. Auth (3 roles, invalid pwd, /me with & without token), cameras, detections (list + plate/camera filters), simulate, trajectory (segment_from_prev + totals), blacklist CRUD with RBAC (403 for operator, 409 duplicate), alerts list + action=acknowledge (status + history), analytics KPIs/hourly (24 buckets)/top-cameras, /api/health, and no _id leakage all confirmed.
passed: POST /api/auth/login admin/operator/investigator all return 200 + token with correct role
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer -> 200 correct user; without token -> 401
GET /api/detections list + ?plate= filter (all match) + ?camera_id= filter (all match) + limit honored
GET /api/trajectory?plate=<seeded>&hours=24 -> hops[] with segment_from_prev {distance_km,minutes,avg_kph}, hop_count=23, total_distance_km=186.26, first_seen/last_seen
POST /api/blacklist as operator -> 403; as investigator -> 200; duplicate -> 409
GET /api/alerts -> list with blacklist_hit alerts; POST /api/alerts/{id}/action acknowledge -> status=acknowledged, history entry appended with by/at/note
GET /api/analytics/kpis -> full KPI object; /hourly -> 24 buckets; /top-cameras -> list of {camera_id,name,count}
